messages:
talia: Hey team — Opal POC kicked off today. They want a chat+search assistant on customer docs. Can we onboard their model `artemis-xl-8k-quant` into the catalog for a Dedicated POC? Need: compatibility check, perf estimate, and answers for their security questionnaire. cc @ashley @ben @jo

ashley: Nice. A couple of asks from the buyer: target median latency ~150ms for short prompts (~50 tokens), cost ceiling they mentioned is conservative. They also require a private VPC option for any PII handling.

ben: Quick Q: what artifact format did they send? HF repo, PT checkpoint, or something custom? We need model size + kv-cache shape to estimate memory. If it's ~16B base quantized to q4/q5, should fit on a single A10x4 pool for POC but need exact numbers and sample traffic.

talia: They uploaded a HF repo link (internal): https://git.internal/opal/artemis-8k. Sample workload: avg prompt 45 tokens, expected response 120 tokens, ~90% single-turn. Security note from them: they want confirmation of encryption in transit/rest and no cross-tenant data sharing.

ben: Got it. Doing a quick local catalog scan. Running: ```rdwctl catalog scan --model artemis-xl-8k --quant q5 --seq-len 8192```

ben: Scan output (summary): compatible: variant=q5, batchable=true, kv_cache_ok=true, est_throughput=420 tok/s per GPU, est_gpu_mem=42GB (incl. kv). No obvious op kernel missing. (will paste full log if you want)

devops-bot: Deploy job queued: compatibility-scan-1778201234. Expected completion ~18 minutes. Status: queued.

ashley: On pricing — Opal asked about short-term reserved capacity pricing vs hosted. Sales wants a POC-friendly commit (1 month) estimate to include in the SOW. @mike-finance can you drop a rough back-of-envelope for 2x A100 reserved for 4w?

mike-finance: Back-of-envelope: 2x A100 reserved (Prod-equivalent) + platform fee => rough $21k/mo list. With POC discount we can offer $12k/month. I'll formalize numbers (network, storage, ops hours) by EOD.

jo: Security flags from the QA: confirm KMS integration for keys, audit logs available (per-route), and retention policy for cached KV/prefixes. Also need signed checksum for the model artifact (sha256). If they can't provide a checksum we need to vet provenance.

talia: They can provide sha256 and are fine with KMS. One blocker on their side: they require function-calling for structured metadata output (i.e., function/schema extraction). Does that work with quantized variants / Dedicated runtime?

ben: Function-calling is a runtime feature, not model-specific. We can enable it on Dedicated. Caveat: quantized weights can slightly change tokenization/outputs — recommend running a 50-prompt eval to compare structured output fidelity.

ashley: Opal wants results by EOD +2 days. Action items: @ben run the eval suite (latency + hallucination/simple fidelity metric) against q5 variant and native fp16 if possible; @mike-finance lock the POC price; @jo prepare the short QA answers + template for KMS/audit. I'll draft the SOW.

ben: Starting eval now. Will post a short table with latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, and a binary hallucination metric for their 50 prompts. If anything fails I'll paste logs and ping infra.

ashley: Thanks — please also include whether KV caching gives visible perf wins on their workload (we expect yes for single-turn with long context).

ben: Noted. I'll include cache/no-cache comparison.

talia: Great. I'll keep Opal updated. If infra needs an extra GPU pool for the POC ping me and I'll request capacity from Dedicated ops.

ashley: Ack. Keeping timeline tight.

jo: One more: copy of the model hash and the license (any restrictive license?) is required before we promote variant into catalog for customer-facing tests.

talia: I'll get the artifact hash and license from Opal now.

ben: Eval started — will update thread with metrics.

mike-finance: I'll follow up with an exported price sheet by EOD.

ashley: Perfect. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
